# konnect_platform_available_regions (Data Source)

## Example Usage

}

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes) Konnect regions available for use, grouped by rollout stage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

### Nested Schema for `regions`
